preparation_steps:
- step_number: 1
  action: ADJUST_PH
  description: Prepare Solution A according to the linked DSMZ 1021 protocol and adjust
    Solution A to pH 8.0. This is not a measured final-medium pH.
- step_number: 2
  action: AUTOCLAVE
  description: For the solid preparation, sterilize Solution A and Solution B separately
    at 121 C for 20 min. Do not autoclave the serum-supplemented mixture.
- step_number: 3
  action: COOL
  description: Cool the separately sterilized solutions to 50 C, then combine A and
    B.
- step_number: 4
  action: MIX
  description: To 4 parts of the combined basal preparation, add 1 part sterile foetal
    or newborn calf serum. Preserve the reported ratio; no fixed serum batch dose
    or mass concentration is asserted.
